prompt: Title (top): "솔버 상태별 첫 점검" + smaller warm-grey "Solver Status Triage". Center top card "계산 실행" branches to three cards: green "optimal", red "infeasible", mauve "unbounded". Under "optimal" place "목적값", "관심 플럭스", "허용오차". Under "infeasible" place "배지", "방향", "결손". Under "unbounded" place "열린 경계", "교환 반응", "수요 반응". Use one red emphasis marker only on the infeasible branch. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every card, tag, branch, and marker has one perfectly uniform solid fill. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no other text, caption, paragraph, logo, or interface label.
